title: After chippy Broncos practice sends Bo Nix to ground, Denver reminds defense its goal is to be 'smart bullies'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: After chippy Broncos practice sends Bo Nix to ground, Denver reminds defense its goal is to be 'smart bullies'
sources.description: "I'm glad that we're fiery, I love the competition out here," offensive coordinator Davis Webb said. But "we can't cross that line, and that's offense and defense."
